item.title: Nonprofit organization helps kids who are hard of hearing find their voice
item.description: Mia is a student at Ohio Valley Voices, a nonprofit center with programs to help kids as young as infants and their families, who are either deaf or severely hard of hearing.

item.title: Campaign to end Ohio property taxes brushes off funding concerns as DeWine warns of 20% sales tax
item.description: As Gov. Mike DeWine warns that Ohio's sales tax would need to go up to 20% if a proposal to abolish property taxes passes this November, campaign organizers argue that it isn't their problem.

item.title: Ohio lawmakers propose series of immigration enforcement bills to limit, expand federal power
item.description: As ICE surges continue, Ohio House Republicans have introduced bills expanding federal enforcement authority and limiting local ability to push back. Democrats introduced their own eight-bill package.
